scope: Original 2020 base/core standard 2–4-player including required two-player House Hagal. Excludes solo, variants and expansions.

questions.question: How is the Conflict Deck built, top to bottom, and what happens to unused Conflict cards?
What are each human player’s starting Agents, troops, water, Influence and VP in three- versus four-player play?
May you Reveal while you still have Agents, and can you take another Agent turn or play a Plot Intrigue later in this phase after that Reveal turn?
What does a legal ordinary Agent turn require regarding card, icons, number of Agents, occupancy, costs and when those costs are paid?
Can an Agent card’s gain of spice pay Conspire’s entry cost when you have only 3 spice? Once legally placed, in what order may card, space and Faction Influence effects resolve?

At a Combat space you recruit 2 troops from its effect and 1 from your card and already have 4 garrisoned. What is the maximum deployment, where do undeployed recruits go, and can Rally Troops normally deploy its recruits?
List the Reveal turn steps in order, whose Reveal boxes are used, and where all played cards go at cleanup.
During your Reveal turn may you buy the replacement for a card you just acquired, combine/split Persuasion, save leftovers, or use the acquired card immediately? When does an Acquire effect happen?
What is strength with 3 troops in the Conflict and 4 revealed swords? What if your last deployed troop is removed, and how are strength values over 20 tracked?
Who can play Combat Intrigue, in what order, does a pass bind later turns, when does combat resolve, and when are “when you win” cards played?
In four-player combat A and B tie for first and C beats D: who wins and what rewards are available? What do ties for second or third yield, what about 0 strength, and where do troops go afterwards?
When are Maker bonus spice and normal harvesting resolved, which spaces use them, and what happens if an Agent has moved away before Makers?

When does the game end if someone reaches 10 VP mid-round or the last Conflict is revealed? What resolves before the winner, and what is the complete tiebreak order including the FAQ’s final fallback?
What happens to the VP at 2 Influence and bonus at 4 if you later drop below them and return? How is an Alliance first gained or taken from a tied holder by advancing?
You hold an Alliance tied at 5 Influence with two opponents, then lose 1 Influence. Who gets it? What if instead you are the only player at 4 and fall to 3?
How do trashing and discarding differ in destination and eligible cards, including Reserve cards? Is trashing always optional, and may you reshuffle an empty deck merely to inspect its top card?
How does control of Arrakeen, Carthag or Imperial Basin pay out on any player’s visit, on winning a new control reward, and when a matching Conflict is revealed later?
Describe complete two-player House Hagal setup, when it takes turns, how many Agents it has, and whether it Reveals, earns VP/resources/rewards or can hold an Alliance.

For a two-player Rival Agent turn, what happens to occupied-space cards, empty deck/Reshuffle, space costs/effects, recruitment, deployment and Harvest Spice bonus? What if a two-space card’s applicable option is occupied?

In two-player Combat how does House Hagal get strength and handle rewards/control, including if it wins a space you control? Do human second-place ties pay the third reward even though ordinary third place is unavailable?
What happens at Round Start and during an ordinary non-ending Recall, including Conflict reveal, hand size, Mentat, Agents and first player?
If the bank runs out of water, spice or Solari, are gains limited? How does running out of troop cubes in your supply differ?
When do Signet Ring and other Leader abilities operate, and can card text override general rules?
At Sietch Tabr, what icon, Influence requirement, effects and deployment permission apply? Can you enter at 1 Fremen Influence and use the card’s effect to reach 2?
Which exact spaces are Combat spaces in this original base game? Are Research Station, The Great Flat and Conspire among them?
For Wealth, Conspire, Foldspace, Heighliner, Secrets, Selective Breeding, Stillsuits and Hardy Warriors, give the entry cost and every board effect, including Influence.
For Arrakeen, Carthag, Research Station, Secure Contract and each Maker space, give entry costs and every board effect, including controller bonuses and bonus spice.
What are the exact Sell Melange exchange rates, can you perform multiple exchanges on one turn, and what is its Agent icon?
What do High Council and Swordmaster cost, how often may each player use them, and when do their benefits begin?
How do Hall of Oratory, Rally Troops and Mentat differ in costs, troops, card draw, Persuasion and Agent benefits?
If a recall effect returns an Agent during your Agent turn, may it be used again this round? Where does it go, and may that permission reopen turns after you have Revealed?
When does Fremen Bond work if one Fremen card was played on an Agent turn and another is now revealed? How long are those cards in play and do two Bond cards enable one another?
May a gain-two-Influence effect be divided between Factions? What must an Alliance-icon or numeric-Influence-icon effect check?
Describe ordinary Intrigue privacy and destination, each type’s timing, what happens if the Intrigue deck runs out, and whether playing an Intrigue may avoid its printed cost or condition.
Can a delayed Plot effect such as Charisma or Recruitment Mission be played during an Agent turn, and when is that card used and discarded?
If you draw a card during your Reveal turn, can you hold it or take an Agent turn with it? What about a card drawn after your Reveal turn?

What can and cannot be declined among ordinary card or board effects, an arrow cost, a black-X trash icon, self-trashing instructions and Intrigue play? Can you repeat a paid arrow effect by paying twice?
When and how must Bindu Suspension be played, and can you continue that Agent turn after its draw?
Can Calculated Hire take the Mentat from another player or from a board space where it was deployed? When do you receive the Mentat for winning Sort Through the Chaos?
Can Kwisatz Haderach take an Agent turn with no unused Agents, return an Agent to its original space, reuse High Council/Swordmaster, or bypass The Voice?
When is The Voice’s marker removed and whom does it stop? What component marks the space?
For Test of Humanity and Reverend Mother Mohiam, who chooses discarded cards, from where, in what order, and may Test of Humanity choose an impossible loss or discard?
When does Baron Harkonnen choose Masterstroke Factions, how are choices hidden, and how often may they be revealed for Influence?

Can Demand Respect be funded by spice just won in the Conflict or by To the Victor…? Can a win-trigger Intrigue just drawn as a victory reward be played now, or a win-trigger card be played on a first-place tie?
When an effect retreats “any number” of troops may you choose zero, and where do retreating versus lost troops go?
Does Assassination Mission trash itself to gain its 4 Solari? Does Imperial Spy draw an Intrigue if another effect trashes it?
Can you keep the VP from acquiring The Spice Must Flow if you later trash it, and does Guild Bankers’ discount apply once per turn or to each copy acquired?
For Corner the Market, which of your The Spice Must Flow cards count and how are opponents compared for its second requirement?
Does Count Ilban’s Ruthless Negotiator trigger for a card ability costing Solari? Can Ariana decline Spice Addict, and does it apply to spice gained outside Maker harvesting?
For Carryall what are the original base spice amounts, and for Liet Kynes which turns’ cards count toward Persuasion?
For Helena’s Manipulate, can opponents acquire the set-aside card, does its discount apply to other acquisition methods, and what happens if you leave it unacquired past your next Reveal turn?
What restrictions apply to Double Cross, Gun Thopter and Guild Envoy even if other parts of the card could operate?
May Shifting Allegiances lose and gain Influence in the same Faction, or pay its loss using a Faction where you have zero? How many spaces per Influence track and where is 3 Influence?
How does Recruitment Mission handle acquisitions during an Agent turn, and can you choose a different destination for each of multiple cards acquired during your Reveal?
What does Refocus do when your discard pile is empty, and what must happen to cards drawn during that Reveal?
What Faction is Missionaria Protectiva, and how many copies belong in the Imperium deck after fixing first-printing misprints?
Can a player score above 12 VP even though the Score track ends at 12?
Are Rivals affected by effects targeting opponents or players, and do they gain Influence-track bonuses or Signet Ring effects in two-player play?
In two-player play, does House Hagal act after the second human’s Agent turns or after the first player Reveals, and how does a Swordmaster affect its number of turns?
May you spend ordinary Reveal-turn Persuasion to buy a Foldspace card from the Reserve, or must an acquisition effect specifically show the Foldspace icon?
After Dispatch an Envoy adds the four Faction Agent icons to a card that already has City and Fremen, do you retain City, and do you now have two Fremen icons?

On a turn when you send an Agent to a Combat space, may troops recruited by a Plot Intrigue that turn deploy along with the space/card recruits? May you count an existing garrison troop as recruited again to bypass the limit of two additional garrison troops?
You must draw three cards but your deck has only one left and you have a nonempty discard pile. What do you draw, when do you shuffle, and do cards still face up in play enter that shuffle?
How do you prepare the humans’ initial decks, the Imperium Row, the Intrigue deck, the Reserve, the Mentat and Alliance tokens, and the initial first player before Round 1?
